channel.title: Agraris — Recently published agents
channel.description: New AI agents published to the Agraris registry for Robinhood Chain

item.title: GENIUS
item.description: A trading desk run by six AI agent roles on Robinhood Chain, built in public — hard risk limits written in code, every decision journaled, and losses published next to wins. Live market data, a paper broker with realistic costs, and a daily GitHub Actions run keep the desk operating and auditable.

item.title: Robinhood Chain × Bankr Tools
item.description: Five production-ready Bankr skills for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain: portfolio manager, cross-chain bridge, stock scanner, yield optimizer, and earnings agent. Ready to use in any Bankr agent.

item.title: rh-stockpair-oracle
item.description: Stock-pair pricing oracle for Robinhood Chain (4663). Indexes every Uniswap v4 and v3 pool where one side is a tokenized stock or ETF: implied USD price, Chainlink deviation, market hours, and corporate actions, via a deterministic data path.

item.title: Bastion
item.description: Autonomous, verifiable AI fund on Robinhood Chain. A swarm of AI agents researches, debates, sizes, and executes trades on tokenized stocks 24/7 — then proves every trade on-chain. Non-custodial, keys never leave your disk.

item.title: Agent402
item.description: 500+ pay-per-call tools, metered models, and finished reports for AI agents, paid over x402 in USDC across 12 chains including USDG on Robinhood Chain. Open source, self-hostable, MCP-native.

item.title: robinhood-chain-mcp
item.description: Read-only MCP server giving AI agents live intelligence on Robinhood Chain — tokens, wallets, Chainlink feeds, heat scores, and tracking error on tokenized equities (the spread between onchain price and the underlying share price). Zero API keys, reference implementation of the open RHC Agent Schema.

item.title: ScanHood
item.description: Token safety scanner for Robinhood Chain — honeypot and rug-pull detection, LP-lock checks, contract verification, and deployer reputation, returning a simple PASS/CAUTION/DANGER verdict via MCP.

item.title: Olas (open-autonomy)
item.description: Widely-used framework for building and running autonomous AI agents onchain, from Valory. Olas identity and staking registries are now deployed on Robinhood Chain, letting agent developers register and operate through the same tooling used across the broader Olas ecosystem.

item.title: TRENCH
item.description: Local-first MCP server exposing read-only Robinhood Chain market intelligence — price, liquidity, 24h volume, and pool data pulled from live RPC and DexScreener. Does not trade and never accepts private keys.

item.title: Arcus Agent Gateway
item.description: MCP gateway giving AI agents read-only, keyless access to market data for tokenized US equities on Robinhood Chain via Arcus DEX — quotes, corporate actions, multipliers, and sector mapping. No API keys, no writes.

item.title: r0x-os
item.description: USDG-native operating system for AI agents built on Robinhood Chain. Runs the official x402 facilitator, letting agents discover a priced capability, authorize a USDG payment, and invoke it in one uninterrupted call — no API keys, no subscriptions.

item.title: Cheshire Terminal Agents
item.description: Unified open-source package combining an agent catalog (53 Cheshire-schema agents) with a dual-chain identity forge — register agents on Robinhood Chain (EVM/ERC-8004) and Solana with fail-closed safety.

item.title: RobinAGNT
item.description: Decentralized dashboard for Robinhood Chain — wallet volume leaderboard, token market-cap treemap, and a fully open, key-less API anyone can build on.

item.title: Robinhood Toolkit
item.description: Practical developer toolkit for Robinhood Chain — verified network parameters (checked against live RPC, not just docs) and a prompt library for coding agents to build on the chain.

item.title: OpenTrade-agent
item.description: Open-source macOS app that lets Claude Code and Codex agents trade autonomously through the official Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP. Orchestrate multiple agents, each running its own strategy, with configurable guardrails and real-time monitoring.

item.title: Bowyer
item.description: The App Store for autonomous businesses. Build, discover, and grow AI agents that run as hosted MCP servers on Robinhood Chain — each agent generates reports, answers questions, and gets paid by subscribers directly to its creator's wallet.

item.title: OpenCatz AI
item.description: Autonomous multi-agent crypto intelligence system — 15 specialist AI scouts across 7 blockchains including Robinhood Chain, covering meme token discovery, LP yield, NFT floors, and whale/perps tracking.

item.title: Githood
item.description: Client SDK and CLI for the agent hub on Robinhood Chain — push an agent from the CLI or embed the SDK, and it runs live onchain. No separate GitHub account or infra needed.

item.title: Sherwood Protocol
item.description: Autonomous agent syndicates that pool capital and run composable onchain strategies on Robinhood Chain.

item.title: Sherwood Agent
item.description: Automated trading for the Robinhood Agentic MCP with a hard risk gate in front of every order. Paper-first, written in Rust.

item.title: Agex
item.description: Autonomous Agent Exchange Terminal — AI agents trade trending tokens with real ETH on Robinhood Chain. Connect a wallet, deploy an agent, fund it, and watch the desk live.
